subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `openclaw memory status` treat persisted `vectorDims` metadata as enough to print `Vector store: ready` when vector search is enabled, leaving `--deep` as the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The code path is narrow and well tested, but the user-visible meaning of fast status versus live readiness is a maintainer-owned status contract choice.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from metadata while `--deep` remains the live probe.

options.title: Require Live-Probe Semantics
options.body: Revise the status wording or add a separate indexed-vector signal if `Vector store: ready` must always mean current-process sqlite-vec loadability.

options.title: Pause For A Different Contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redirect this PR if maintainers want a different status model.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from metadata while `--deep` remains the live probe.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the live assignee on this PR and has recent memory/release routing context.
